cards.details: First Council at Rajgir, held immediately after Buddha's Mahaparinirvana under King Ajatashatru.
Second Council at Vaishali, held 100 years after the First Council to settle disputes over monastic rules (Vinaya).
Third Council at Pataliputra under Ashoka to purge the Sangha of corruption and reconcile texts.
Fourth Council at Kundalvana (Kashmir) under Kanishka, resulting in the formal split into Hinayana and Mahayana.

traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Confusing the 4th Council: It was held under Kanishka in Kashmir, not in Pataliputra.
Assuming the Tripitakas were finished at the 1st council: Sutta and Vinaya were compiled, but Abhidhamma was added later.
Misidentifying the split: The formal split into Mahayana and Hinayana happened in the 4th Council, not the 3rd.
Ignoring the 'Fifth' Council: Mandalay (1871) is technically an international council, but for UPSC, focus on the 'Four Councils'.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Key Locations

  • Rajgir (Sattapani Cave)
  • Vaishali
  • Pataliputra
  • Kundalvana (Kashmir)

Chief Presiding Monks

  • Mahakasyapa (1st)
  • Sabakami (2nd)
  • Moggaliputta Tissa (3rd)
  • Vasumitra & Ashvaghosha (4th)

Evolutionary Mindmap

  • First Council (Objective: Preserving Buddha's Teachings)
    • Compiled Sutta Pitaka (Ananda) and Vinaya Pitaka (Upali).
  • Second Council (Objective: Discipline/Vinaya Rules)
    • Debate between Sthaviras and Mahasanghikas (Schism start).
  • Third Council (Objective: Orthodoxy)
    • Compiled Abhidhamma Pitaka; Rejected heretical monks.
  • Fourth Council (Objective: Doctrinal Shift)
    • Commentaries (Vibhasha Shastras) written; Formal Mahayana/Hinayana split.
